desc: Lucky stat gains (scripts/core/luck.gd, briefs/design/BOKI_PLAYSTYLE_GROWTH.md 'Lucky bonus', owner 2026-11-27). Every whole point a Boki gains from an expedition (PlayStyle.run_growth) or a stat bite (GardenItems.apply) rolls a lucky chance to be worth +2. Luck only speeds a gain that already happened: it never adds a point on its own and never passes a stat cap, the total cap or a grade.
base_doc: Lucky chance per point gained with no buff (0..1).
cap_doc: Highest lucky chance with every buff on.
tiers_doc: Chance added for a while by a luck treat (items of family luck): liked = any treat, rare_liked = a rare treat it has no special love for, fav = its favourite treat, rare_fav = its favourite when that treat is a rare one.
charges_doc: Stat gains (a bite eaten, or one stat's growth from an expedition) a treat's buff lasts for. A stronger treat replaces a weaker one, a weaker one never lowers a stronger one.
toy_doc: Chance added for the next expedition after a finished play at the Boki's favourite toy (FavToy). It ends when that expedition has paid its growth.
rare_fav_doc: Share of Boki whose hidden favourite treat is a rare one (picked from the Boki's id, so it never changes).
